 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Week 10 Rico Dowdle Fantasy Start or Sit 2026 Should you start or sit Pittsburgh Steelers running back Rico Dowdle against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 10? PFN's Jacob Infante examines Dowdle's fantasy outlook after two productive performances heading into Pittsburgh's bye week. Dowdle scored 14.6 fantasy points against the Saints in Week 7 and 11.6 against the Browns in Week 8, demonstrating his potential as both a runner and receiver. However, Jaylen Warren remains the primary option in Pittsburgh's backfield, creating questions about Dowdle's weekly workload and fantasy ceiling. Can Dowdle continue producing against Cincinnati despite sharing touches? Get Jacob's Week 10 Start/Sit breakdown before finalizing your lineup!
